result.instructions: ERPNext/Frappe tools with server-side user permissions. This connection provides read access plus approval-gated action requests. Discover DocTypes and schemas before querying. Never invent document names or field names. Action-request tools do not modify documents directly; they create a pending approval. Results carry a structured `summary` for you and a `presentation` that the host renders for the user: do not re-print tables or repeat the numbers, add analysis and the next step instead. When an approval is pending, the user may click the card's button OR approve in chat: if they say 'موافق' / 'اعتمد' / 'نفذ', call approvals__list_pending (or approvals__decide with the approval_id you just received) and approve; never approve without the user's explicit word. approvals__decide executes, verifies and returns the document link. If the request needs prerequisite records (a customer or item that does not exist), put them in ONE bulk request, and once the user approves it continue with the main document (for example the invoice) in the same task instead of presenting the prerequisites as the final result. Ask with app__choose when a choice is ambiguous (which company, which warehouse) instead of guessing.

tools.title: تحليل المبيعات
tools.description: Sales analysis for a period: total sales, invoice and customer counts, average invoice and the top customers with their share (read only, permission-scoped)

company.description: Company to analyse; required when companies use different currencies

top.description: How many top customers to rank, default 5

tools.name: app__choose
tools.title: اختيار من قائمة
tools.description: Ask the user to pick one option instead of guessing (for example which company or warehouse). Use source=companies or source=warehouses to list what the user can read, or pass options. In hosts with MCP Apps the user sees a choice card and the answer arrives as their next message; elsewhere the same numbered list is in the text: ask them to reply.

tools.name: app__probe
tools.title: فحص اتصال واجهة MCP App
tools.description: Read-only connection check for the MCP App view: returns the number of companies the user can read. Renders a minimal view in hosts that support MCP Apps; plain text and structuredContent elsewhere.

tools.name: approvals__decide
tools.title: الموافقة على طلب أو رفضه
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending approval request. Use it when the user explicitly approves in chat ('موافق', 'اعتمد', 'نعم نفذ') or rejects ('ألغِ', 'لا'). Approving executes the action, verifies the created/changed document and returns its link; when the request carried a next step (`then`) the server prepares it and returns that next request too. Never call it without an explicit decision from the user. The card's buttons call the same tool with a signed token.

token.description: Set by the approval card only; leave empty from chat.

tools.name: approvals__list_pending
tools.title: طلبات الموافقة المعلّقة
tools.description: The user's own pending approval requests. Call it when the user says 'موافق' / 'اعتمد' / 'نفذ' / 'yes go ahead' without naming a request: one pending request → decide on it; several → the result asks the user which one; none → say so.

tools.name: approvals__revise
tools.title: تعديل طلب قبل الموافقة (من البطاقة)
tools.description: App-only. Change quantity, price, company or warehouse of a pending create request before approval.

tools.name: approvals__status
tools.title: حالة طلب موافقة
tools.description: Read the current state of an approval request (pending, executed, rejected, expired, failed) and its result.
